evidence_summary: Built full process window: 14136 self-consistent states over the admissible domain.
Computed all reference atomic activities; candidate_04 is the highest-activity candidate, but candidate_13 is the lowest-cost industrial candidate.
Optimized all 15 candidates; only candidate_13, candidate_04, and candidate_05 are feasible under the 90 m3 bed cap.
Candidate_13 has the lowest deterministic canonical cost, 15.2917 USD/t, versus 22.0306 USD/t for candidate_04 and 25.8318 USD/t for candidate_05.

Parity analysis shows candidate_04 would need a 201.2x intrinsic-activity multiplier to equal candidate_13 cost; frozen descriptor scaling can supply only 2.52x across the process window, so parity by activity alone is unreachable.

Optimized all 15 candidates; only candidate_13, candidate_04, and candidate_05 are feasible under the 90 m3 bed cap.
